title: The derived session.prompt_deliveries view is persisted in the session row beside the receipt map
outcome: The derived session.prompt_deliveries view is persisted in the session row beside the receipt map
acceptance: PersistedSessionRecord::from_record clears the derived session.prompt_deliveries view for local sessions, as it does session.pending_prompts, and the load path rebuilds the view unconditionally from the receipt map, so a stale persisted view is never loaded as-is.
A test round-trips a session with receipts and one with an empty receipt map, asserting the persisted row carries no view and the loaded view matches the map.
